Brand kit, version 2

Milton Pace Music Academy

One system across the website, the My Music Staff build and anything Luna posts. Colours, type, logo rules, photography direction and social templates. Built on the Block Concept 1 brand sheet and the locked lockup, and matched to the re-skinned site, so nothing here contradicts what is already built.

Logo

Do

  • Clear space on all sides equal to the cap height of MUSIC ACADEMY.
  • Minimum width 220px on screen so the tagline line stays legible, otherwise use a crop without it.
  • Colour lockup on warm white. White lockup on jet black, charcoal, collegiate red or a dark photo.
  • Over photography, place it in the calmest quarter of the frame with a dark scrim behind it.

Do not

  • Recolour the wordmark, including all gold or all white on light grounds.
  • Stretch, rotate, add a drop shadow or a second outline.
  • Put the colour lockup on red, gold or any dark field.
  • Re-typeset the name, the lockup is the artwork.

Colour

Ratios are measured against warm white #f7f4ee and jet black #111111. Aged gold is decorative: rules, stars and large text only. Gold ink is the small text version.

Rules

  • One collegiate red per screen. It belongs to the primary action, nothing else.
  • Dark sections use jet black with warm white text. Never body copy in gold.
  • Eyebrows and small accents use gold ink on warm white, aged gold only on dark.
  • Red soft is a wash, never a text colour.

Photography

  • Warm golden key light, deep brown falloff, never cool or clinical.
  • One subject mid playing, caught rather than posed. Faces lit, eyes readable.
  • Rooms look lived in: music stands, cases, wood, sheet music.
  • Crops: 16:9 hero bands, 4:5 program tiles, 1:1 teacher cards, 4:3 story bands.
  • Generated portraits of real staff are built from their own photos with facial features locked.

Voice

  • Plain and warm. Short sentences. Say what the thing is.
  • Lead with the person, not the institution. "Nobody here has to be good yet" over "excellence in music education".
  • No em dashes, no exclamation marks, no stacked adjectives.
  • One ask per section, and it is almost always the free intro lesson.

Social templates

Three ready layouts in this folder, open them in a browser and screenshot at the stated size, or hand them to Luna as is: social-square.html 1080 x 1080, social-story.html 1080 x 1920, social-share.html 1200 x 630. Each one carries the same type scale, the same red, and the same photo treatment.
